Given the columns, we'll compute the total across all numeric item columns, including Soda, to present a complete sales figure for the chain.

```python
import pandas as pd
file_path = "/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/7bd855d8-463d-4ed5-93ca-5fe35145f733.xlsx"

all_sales_total = df[item_cols].sum().sum()
print(f"Total sales (all items): ${all_sales_total:.2f}")
```
